summary: Osun first-party pages evidence a local Ministry of Lands and Physical Planning and Office of the Surveyor General with land-registry, cadastral and geospatial responsibilities. The official helpful-links page identifies an Osun Land Parcel Information System, but its host timed out by DNS; the related lands host failed TLS validation; and the accessible CofO site is document verification, not an anonymous parcel geometry service. No GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Yoruba discovery queries, exact text, outcomes and actual result URLs are recorded in city-4196-erin-osun.json.
requestOutcomes: Official Osun custodian pages, helpful-links page and CofO landing page were checked. The linked parcel-system host timed out; lands.osunstate.gov.ng failed certificate validation and was not accessed with verification disabled; the CofO page exposed no safe anonymous parcel geometry route.
